numeric_rule: Recompute Mean from complete selected latest pre-frame Raw; alias-deduplicated support groups, per-group normalized vectors in float64, same zero-resultant refusal as Mean. Retained routing count is separate; quality aggregation preserves original arithmetic. Empty tombstones unavailable.
atomic_rule: All current groups score against one frozen original bank with independent query-specific views; one real post-frame commit after every score succeeds; whole frame rolls back on error.
history_rule: Original prediction-owned bank, dirty versions, transfer parents and tombstones remain. Chosen original version is conservative history-only; it does NOT bind the filtered numeric prototype. Extra query-aligned Raw/numeric digests must enter any registered evaluator probe/receipt.
known_limitations: No real full-policy/full-development shadow or metrics yet. No selection on dev/final. Different video/route is not semantic independence. Registration still requires complete frozen clocks/denominators, all view bindings and actual ID/future probes, fair controls, coverage and latency. A later M control must recompute its weights from selected Raw, not reuse polluted latent weights.
